Name: (CP-AT-FF) Antique TV Set
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/7DxaSXe.png[/img]
Bring your new antique tv set in your house by purchasing it on furniture catalogue!
I have put together different files in the Main Files for you to choose. You should only CHOOSE 1.
The [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP [/url][/b]version replaces the default TV (floor and budget tv)
The [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]AT [/url][/b]version lets you change its textures
The [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]FF [/url][/b]version adds these TVs as new item (much like DGA).[b] [/b]You should buy the TVs first from Robin. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QQLWQzM.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/EwJVIBf.png[/img]
Assuming you already have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
1. Download requirements (see 'requirements' tab)
2. Download the mod 
3. Put the mods in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

[img]https://imgur.com/2oBiKnQ.png[/img]
For [b]CP [/b]version only.
You can go to settings in-game and scroll down until you find 'Mod Options' or 'Mod Config' 
Under it, you can see the name of this mod.
You have the option to enable (default value) or disable it.[color=#ff0000] Disabling this mod removes your tv the next in-game day.[/color]

[img]https://imgur.com/48TG8z2.png[/img]
Credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9847182]Medinaquirin [/url]for letting me convert [i]their [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4799]Antique TV Sets (CP)[/url] mod! Please give kudos to [i]them [/i]as [i]their [/i]works are one of the most adorable designs out here ♥

A huge thank you and applause to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Leroymilo/mods?gameId=1303]Leroymilo[/url] ﻿for helping me from the start. Without [i]their[/i] help, the FF version of the mod wouldn't have been smoothly completed. Please make sure to check out [i]their [/i]works!
